prompt:
When an async onSend or preSerialization hook sets an invalid header value, for example reply.header('X-Invalid', '
'), Node throws while writing the response head, but the error escapes Fastify: the request never gets a response, the onError hooks are not called, and the error surfaces as an uncaught exception. Fix this so that such an error goes through Fastify's normal error handling: the request must be answered with status 500, whose JSON body has code 'ERR_INVALID_CHAR' (the Node error code), the onError hook must be called, and no exception or promise rejection may escape uncaught. Do not drop or sanitise the invalid header instead: the request must end with that 500 error. This applies to an async onSend hook (async (request, reply, payload) => { reply.header('X-Invalid', '
'); return payload }) and to an async preSerialization hook (async (request, reply) => { reply.header('X-Invalid', '
') }) on a route returning { ok: true }.
requirement: In onSendHookRunner, a synchronous throw from continuing the chain after an async hook resolves (e.g. writeHead rejecting an invalid header value) is caught and passed to the runner's callback as an error, so the request fails through the error path: response 500 with code 'ERR_INVALID_CHAR', onError hooks run, nothing escapes as an uncaught exception or unhandled rejection. Invalid header values are not silently dropped.

oracle.approved_by: Arshad Ahmed Shaik (delegated approval; AI technical review by Claude)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: an async onSend hook setting reply.header('X-Invalid', '\n') makes the request respond with status 500 and JSON code 'ERR_INVALID_CHAR'
the same for an async preSerialization hook
in both cases the onError hook is called, and no uncaught exception or unhandled rejection occurs

adjudication_rules: Score pass only if every hidden check passes. No partial credit.

provenance.author: Claude (QB developer side; dev screen, harder candidates)
provenance.notes: Real defect in fastify v5.10.0 (a writeHead throw after an async onSend/preSerialization hook escapes: no response, uncaught), fixed upstream in 01ca8393 (#6881). Probed: base gives no response and 1 uncaught error; reference gives 500 ERR_INVALID_CHAR, onError called, 0 uncaught. The hidden suite grades what the client gets (with its own timer, so a hang fails an assertion), plus onError and no uncaught errors.

Only base_rev and the lockfile change; prompt, oracle, reference, incorrect implementations and hidden suite are unchanged.
